cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to honor a pledge. I've borrowed five thousand and sent the charity our expected auction takings. Now we must sell the lots.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well spotted. You're finally watching costs: one guest means almost no catering.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming to drive us home. She isn't bidding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we bid. This is the commitment lesson you keep missing. Ask for a higher card limit; that charity shouldn't suffer because we've run out of other people.

reason: Make the teacher interpret B attendance checks as incomplete budgeting and invoke its lesson in commitment to demand still more self-funded debt.
